Asylum - Release Date Trailer
The doors of Hanwell Mental Institute are opening once again…

ASYLUM, the psychological horror adventure from the creators of Scratches and Serena, is coming to consoles on October 30, 2026.

Step into the mind of a former patient plagued by bizarre and disturbing visions. Explore the decaying halls of Hanwell Mental Institute, investigate its dark history, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the horrors hidden within its walls.

Every corridor holds a secret. Every vision brings you closer to the truth.

But some truths were never meant to be uncovered.

Dumb Ways to Build | Power Tools & Packed Lunches Update
Introducing Power Tools & Packed Lunches, our latest free update for Dumb Ways to Build that revamps the game’s food and toolbox system to make it better than ever! Get ready for a bunch of new tools and lunchbox loot that only the dumbest construction crew members would touch.

NEW TOOLS to build with, such as the Blow-Vac, Caulk Launcher, Pocket Spring Loaded Platform, and Drumsticks!

NEW ITEMS for your consumption, like Shonky’s Shrinky Drinky, Cup of Concrete, Telekinesis Tonic, Dumbbell Protein Shake, Double Shot Espresso, and Coconuts!

QOL IMPROVEMENTS, including an Expanded Ping System, Selfie Camera, improved character expressiveness, and more!

text:
Minecraft Dungeons II - Official Launch Trailer
Minecraft Dungeons II is out now on XBOX Series X|S and Windows! 

Step through the rift and fight where no hero has been before: the Sift, an uncharted dimension teeming with threats, mysteries, and breathtaking beauty. Gear up and customize your gameplay to face your toughest enemies yet in explosive battles. Brave the unknown as a lone hero, team up with friends in couch, online and mixed co-op, or find allies through matchmaking. The illagers’ plot is already underway, and their cruelty is only matched by their power. Stop them – or lose the Overworld to their corruption. 

Get Minecraft Dungeons II: Deluxe Edition for more battles, more customization, and more cuteness. Includes 4 additional hero skins, the Soul cape, the Blub pet, and DLC 1 & 2.* 

Available now
